text:
incident-bot: PROD: elevated error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 > 4x baseline for 5m. Severity=P1. Pager: eng-oncall. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/9123 :rotating_light:

Sam (on-call): acknowledging. Paging rotation: Sam here. Do not merge prod changes while we triage.

Rita SRE: pulling logs + dashboards now. Heads up: traces look very sparse for this window. Sampling appears to drop ~12:10:00 UTC -> 12:12:30 UTC.

Jordan (eng-runtime): seeing RPC failures from model-router -> worker pool: "cancelled" and "resource exhausted" errors, then 502s to clients.

Priya (eng-infra): I can check infra-bot and config-store audit. Running audit query for writes to `observability.sampler.rate` since 2026-04-01.

Tess CS: Customer reports coming in from Beta group (WidgetCo) around 12:11. Ticket #CS-1199. They saw repeated 502s for a few minutes.

Sam (on-call): Jordan, paste last few worker errors and GPU/memory metrics for 12:05-12:15.

Jordan (eng-runtime): logs (redacted):

```
[12:09:58] ERROR worker-12: inference rpc: resource exhausted (code=8)
[12:10:02] WARN router: high queue latency id=xyz789
[12:10:04] ERROR worker-15: cuda failed to allocate 1.2GiB (OOM?)
[12:10:05] ERROR router: upstream 502 for id=xyz789
[12:10:07] INFO scaler: scale-up signal detected, requested=2 nodes
```

Rita SRE: scale events show nodes were requested but provisioning lag was ~45s. Also our trace collector shows sampling changed from 1.0 -> 0.02 at 12:09:59 performed by service `infra-bot` with reason `nightly-housekeeping`. Audit record: https://audit.redwood.internal/ev/4729

Priya (eng-infra): I checked the infra cron job. There was a maintenance run that included a temporary lower sampling to reduce cost during backups. That job should only run in non-prod but a config selector bug widened the scope. Opening emergency roll: `infra/cron -> patch to selector` now.

Sam (on-call): So observability was reduced because of a mis-scoped cron. We still need to know if the OOMs are because of request size or batching. Jordan, do we have request payload size distribution for the window?

Jordan (eng-runtime): pulling request log fields. Running: `grep 'request_size' logs | jq '.request_size' | sort -n | uniq -c`

Jordan (eng-runtime): result: 8 requests > 15000 tokens, 30 requests between 5k-12k, rest < 2k. The >15k ones are all from the same customer token (WidgetCo experiment).

Rita SRE: also seeing an increase in scheduler batch sizes at 12:09:55 from target 6 -> bursts of 18 due to concurrency. That plus large payloads = recipe for OOM.

Sam (on-call): Hypotheses (tracking inline):
- H1: mis-scoped infra cron lowered tracing sampler -> sparse traces, slowed detection.
- H2: a burst of large requests from WidgetCo + aggressive batching produced GPU memory exhaustion -> worker OOMs -> RPC errors -> 502s.
- H3: provisioning slowness on autoscaler amplified the impact (scale-up delay).

Rita SRE: tagging H1/H2/H3. Evidence so far: audit entry for sampler change (H1), request-size histogram (H2), scale-up latency (H3).

Priya (eng-infra): rolled back the cron selector at 12:13:10 UTC and pushed a hotfix to ensure the maintenance job only targets `env:nonprod` (deploy id infra-ht-772).

Sam (on-call): Good. Can someone re-enable full tracing to validate?

Priya (eng-infra): re-enabled to 1.0 at 12:13:30. Rita: traces returning?

Rita SRE: traces density returned by ~12:13:55. We now have better span coverage to reconstruct pre-failure path.

Jordan (eng-runtime): mitigation actions applied: 1) temporarily drop max batch size from 18 -> 6 at 12:14:00, 2) apply soft-reject on requests > 12k tokens (respond with 413 + message) at 12:14:20. After that, OOMs stopped and 502s dropped.

Tess CS: WidgetCo notified via interim message at 12:16 with basic summary and offered follow-up. No SLA credit yet; we are collecting impact window.

Sam (on-call): Quick timeline (draft):
- 12:09:59 UTC: infra-bot cron accidentally lowered observability.sampler.rate (1.0 -> 0.02)
- 12:09:55 UTC: spike of large requests and concurrency; batching increased
- 12:09:58 UTC: first worker OOM and rpc resource exhausted errors
- 12:10:05 UTC: customer-visible 502s begin; WidgetCo reports
- 12:13:10 UTC: infra cron selector patched (rollback)
- 12:13:30 UTC: sampler re-enabled to 1.0
- 12:14:00 UTC: batch size lowered -> mitigation
- 12:14:20 UTC: soft-reject >12k tokens applied

Rita SRE: I'm creating an evidence list in the RCA doc with links: logs, audit, metrics, spike charts. Also noticed a dashboard panel had incorrect time-range that hid the initial spike; will file dashboard fix ticket.

Priya (eng-infra): action items right now: 1) block infra-bot from writing live sampling configs in prod (owner: eng-infra), 2) add approval gate for config-store writes that change observability.* in prod (owner: eng-platform).

Jordan (eng-runtime): runtime actions: 1) enforce max token limit via gateway so workers never see >12k (owner: eng-runtime), 2) add alert for >X concurrent large requests (owner: eng-runtime), 3) adjust autoscaler to prefer warm pools for sudden bursts (owner: eng-infra+eng-runtime).

Tess CS: CS actions: 1) notify affected customers with incident window and mitigation (owner: CS), 2) review experiments to throttle large requests from beta customers (owner: CS+product).

Sam (on-call): Handing off: I need to go offline in 8m. @Rita will continue to own evidence collection and timeline, @Jordan will monitor worker OOM and batching metrics. If things regress, escalate to me.

Rita SRE: opening RCA draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/rca/INC-9123-draft and adding initial hypothesis/evidence. Also creating a short-term task to fix dashboard time-range (task #TASK-5421).

Jordan (eng-runtime): monitoring shows stable since 12:16, no further OOMs. I'll open PRs for gateway token limit and alert before EOD.

Priya (eng-infra): will follow up on infra-bot cron audit and add unit tests to avoid selector bug.

Sam (on-call): Thanks team. Closing slack thread for now; follow-ups in RCA doc and assigned tickets. :white_check_mark:
